standard_prerequisites.name: The reduction of limits to products and equalizers
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 6139-6141) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Restricts the assertion to those two shapes of limits.

core_obligations: Products: give the product of the underlying rings the product topology and use that the product of the spaces of the factors is the space of the product of the pairwise products, so that addition and multiplication stay continuous (proof lines 6142-6147)
Equalizers: take the equalizer as maps of topological spaces and endow it with the induced topology, which is the same as the equalizer in rings with its natural topology (proof lines 6147-6150)
proof_roadmap: 由「极限 = 积与等化子」的引理，只需处理这两种。
积：取底层环之积与积拓扑；由积与积交换，加法与乘法连续。
等化子：取拓扑空间层面的等化子并赋予诱导拓扑，即得环层面的等化子。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the category of topological rings has limits and that limits commute with the forgetful functors to topological spaces and to rings (author lemma at source lines 6131-6136, label lemma-topological-ring-limits). The proof (source lines 6138-6151) reduces to products and equalizers, checks continuity of the operations on the product using that products commute with products, and takes the equalizer of the underlying topological spaces (proof lines 6138-6150). The two constructions are the content. H3.
